import pytest
from store.cart import Item
try:
    from store.cart import Cart
except ImportError:
    from store.cart import ShoppingCart as Cart
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_exactly_50_free_shipping():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    assert c.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5000 >= 5000 -> free, expect 0


def test_issue_just_below_threshold_charged():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=4999, qty=1))
    assert c.shipping_cents() == 599  # 4999 < 5000 -> flat 599


def test_issue_just_above_threshold_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=5001, qty=1))
    assert c.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5001 >= 5000 -> free, expect 0


def test_issue_quantity_total_exactly_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=1250, qty=4))
    assert c.shipping_cents() == 0  # 1250*4=5000 >= 5000 -> free, expect 0


def test_issue_discounted_to_50_percent_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=10000, qty=1))
    c.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")
    assert c.shipping_cents() == 0  # 10000-5000=5000 >= 5000 -> free, expect 0


def test_issue_discounted_to_50_fixed_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=6000, qty=1))
    c.apply_coupon("TENOFF")
    assert c.shipping_cents() == 0  # 6000-1000=5000 >= 5000 -> free, expect 0


def test_issue_empty_cart_no_shipping():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    c = Cart()
    assert c.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty -> 0, no shipping charge


def test_contract_subtotal_sums_lines():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line in the cart."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=2))
    c.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=500, qty=1))
    assert c.subtotal_cents() == 2500  # 1000*2+500*1=2500


def test_contract_add_same_sku_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    assert c.items[0].qty == 2  # 1+1=2


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    c.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):  # second coupon must raise CouponError
        c.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")


def test_contract_percent_rounds_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    c.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert c.discount_cents() == 19  # 199*10//100=19 rounded down


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up to the cent."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=7, qty=1))
    assert c.tax_cents() == 1  # 7*8/100=0.56 rounds half up to 1


def test_contract_total_sums_components():
    """total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    c = Cart()
    c.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    assert c.total_cents() == 5400  # 5000+0+400=5400
